text:
maria: onboarding friction report — new dev following the JS SDK quickstart for edge function in our monorepo (yarn workspace) hit import resolution + duplicate-types + auth retry flakiness.
maria: runtime: Cloudflare worker build failed with `Cannot find module 'node:buffer'` and later `The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.cjs' does not provide an export named 'default'`
dan: hmm, `node:` builtins + CJS entrypoint in an ESM-only runtime. Which bundler?
maria: using Wrangler with esbuild/bundling enabled, yarn v3 PnP disabled (classic hoisting). The workspace has local workspace:link for @redwood/sdk.
kai: yarn classic vs v3 PnP changes resolution. With hoisting you can get two copies: the hoisted package and the workspace symlink. That breaks singletons.
sam: auth retry behavior — we saw retries that drop headers. Repro: initial request with token 200, then transient 5xx, retry sends request without Authorization.
lina: that usually means the authorization header is added by an interceptor on an instance that isn't used for the retry or a cloned request lost headers during redirect/retry. In a mono workspace dup install scenario, the interceptor might be on a different SDK copy.
maria: here's our package.json `exports` for the SDK: 
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
    },
    "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
```

maria: note we publish both esm and cjs. esbuild for workers should prefer the import path but the packager resolved require for some reason.
dan: quick fixes: 1) add a `browser` field that points to the ESM bundle for browser/edge runtimes, 2) provide a top-level `module`/`import` field, or 3) instruct esbuild to prefer the `import` entry: `mainFields: ['module','main']`.
kai: for yarn workspaces, ensure only one physical copy of @redwood/sdk exists. `yarn why @redwood/sdk` and `ls -la node_modules/@redwood/sdk` to check symlinks. If you see multiple node_modules trees, that's the cause.
sam: workaround for auth: patch the SDK to expose `attachGlobalAuth(client)` that sets `globalThis.__rw_auth__ = client` and the retry layer picks it up if local instance missing. It's an opt-in though.
lina: types dup: TS shows `Duplicate identifier 'ClientOptions'` — caused by two copies of `index.d.ts` being reachable. Workarounds: set `skipLibCheck: true` in tsconfig, or add `paths` mapping in root tsconfig to point to the hoisted package's types.
maria: developer pain: the quickstart's sample uses `yarn workspace run` which hides the fact that different installs are used by the bundler vs node. New dev had to switch to pnpm to get consistent hoisting.
dan: we should update the quickstart: call out workspace patterns (yarn classic vs pnpm vs yarn pnp) and recommended bundler settings. Also include a one-liner alias for esbuild: `alias: { '@redwood/sdk': path.resolve(__dirname, '../node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.mjs') }`.
kai: long term: consider publishing a single flat ESM entry at `dist/esm/index.mjs` and an `exports` condition that prioritizes `import`. Example `exports` shape that favors import-only consumers: 
```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "browser": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
    }
  }
}
```
sam: also add runtime dev warning when SDK loaded more than once: in dev builds increment `globalThis.__rw_sdk_instances__` and console.warn if >1 with a stack sample.
maria: we added a small repro repo in the issue already — includes yarn workspace, sample worker, and steps. deploy-bot opened it: 
deploy-bot: opened issue #892: "devex: workspace-edge-sdk-resolution-typing-auth" with repro and labels: devex, sdk, edge, monorepo
lina: follow-ups for SDK team: 1) add stronger ESM-first package config + browser field, 2) consider opt-in global attach for auth client, 3) produce a single flattened d.ts build, 4) docs: workspace quickstart with aliases and tsconfig tips.
dan: follow-ups for devex docs: write a troubleshooting checklist for monorepo + edge: hoisting checks, bundler mainFields, alias example, TS paths, and a sample pnpm/yarn config.
kai: note for Cloudflare/Bun/Vercel edge: some runtimes rewrite imports and strip `node:` prefixes. Provide polyfills or avoid node builtin usage in edge-targeted bundles.
sam: small note about retries: ensure our retry middleware clones headers or re-runs auth token resolution per-retry rather than copying a possibly stale header. Add unit tests to cover header-preservation across retry/backoff.
maria: new dev completed onboarding after applying alias + skipLibCheck. but we should make those fixes upstream. Thanks all :thumbsup:
lina: I'll add a short guide in devex repo and link issue #892.
dan: assigning owners for SDK changes.
kai: closing loop — add a sample with pnpm workspace too, since pnpm tends to be less surprising for hoisting.
maria: cheers, closing thread.
